sections.name: mission
sections.value: You build ONE unit of plan 128-seat-session-identity: u2 shim union + whoami JSON + extension sends session. Route sessions through the rs shim, merge legacy and rs rows without renaming the frozen legacy fields, dedupe by pijId, add generation, enable rs whoami JSON, and propagate omp/pi session ids. Report to PM pij-eastern-guppy, not prime.

value.text: Orient: cd /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-seat-session-identity-u2; use ABSOLUTE paths for every file operation; symlink /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij/node_modules into the worktree if absent; read your u2 row, amended plan G3, and phase tasks. Run harness boot --json before changes. For every meaning-shaped question run flowspace3 search before grep; report every miss or confusing envelope as friction.

Ack FIRST via pij tooling: pij send pij-eastern-guppy "<numbered implementation plan, tests, defects/dead premises, exact worktree root, LSP availability>". Write no code until the PM rules the ack by number.

Implement with /builder discipline, RED-first, against a fake /v1/shim/sessions answer using the frozen legacy field names. Prove route/path agreement, merge+dedupe by pijId, both whoami shapes, registration harness_session payload, and envelope version bump.
Stay inside u2 paths. Do not touch Rust paths, migration/schema, delivery/typing paths, production daemon state, .harness/government/**, or plan flow. Outside-path need = STOP and ask PM.
Commit with harness commit using a conventional commit. Report status at start and finish with pij report now.
Done = targeted Vitest plus harness checks green in YOUR worktree; never restart the production daemon. Report evidence and hold for composition questions; do not merge.
Capture friction immediately with harness observe; list, never clear.

Use OMP TypeScript LSP for symbol references/definitions/refactors and structured edit/diagnostic tools. If TypeScript LSP is unavailable, report it at ack rather than silently replacing all symbol work with grep.
The PM is your interface: acks, questions, done reports. You never message prime or Jordan directly unless the PM's seat is dead.
DEFER to the PM: interface changes (they affect sibling units), dependency additions, schema/migration changes, anything outside your paths.
Your evidence outranks the packet: if the brief is wrong, say so at ack or stop-and-ask with the measurement — do not silently code around it.

value.fence: .pi/extensions/pij/core/generation-routing.ts; .pi/extensions/pij/adapters/generation-router.ts; .pi/extensions/pij/core/cli.ts sessions and whoami JSON branches only; .pi/extensions/pij/core/daemon-wire.ts Registration field; .pi/extensions/pij/adapters/rust-runtime.ts harness_session send; .pi/extensions/pij/index.ts piSessionId pass-through; directly related TypeScript tests
value.forbidden_note: Never touch u1/Rust paths, .harness/government/**, production daemon state, or plan flow state. Never merge/open PR. ABSOLUTE PATHS for every read/edit. Frozen contract: rs already emits legacy field names; u2 merges/dedupes/tags and NEVER renames.

value.text: Unit implements the interface contract in the impl-guide row, verbatim or with PM-ruled amendments.
Unit test suite passes standalone and proves the contract.

harness checks green in your worktree — AND prove the change is IN THE TREE YOU BUILT, not just that the build exited 0: cite tree-resident evidence (the lockfile carries your dependency, mtime/git status shows your file, the artifact names your module). An exit code is honest about what it built and silent about what it did not.

The SNAP-IN RECIPE shipped with the unit (tenet 4): the exact wiring the composer will paste — config shape, construction call, registration line — as a doc comment or section in your unit's service page. Wire it in yourself ONLY when both hold: the wiring file is uncontended (no sibling unit touches it) AND your done bar is behavioural (unreachable unwired); the recipe still ships so composition verifies rather than re-derives. Otherwise the composer wires. (Amended 2026-08-28: the blanket never-wire rule contradicted a live probe-flip done bar.)

Done report to PM: what shipped, evidence, deviations, anything the composer must know — INCLUDING an explicit ASSUMPTIONS section: everything you assumed about the composition you do not own (who calls you, in what order, with what already in the store). A green gate proves your unit against YOUR assumptions; naming them is what lets the composer test them.
